vocabulary.name: ISBNdb API Vocabulary
vocabulary.description: Domain vocabulary for the ISBNdb API covering book metadata, identifiers, and publishing concepts.

terms.definition: International Standard Book Number — a numeric commercial book identifier. ISBNdb supports both ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 formats.
The 10-digit form of the International Standard Book Number used before 2007.
The 13-digit EAN-based form of the International Standard Book Number, standard since 2007.
The Dewey Decimal Classification system number(s) assigned to a book for library cataloging purposes.
The physical form of a book's cover and binding — common values include Hardcover, Paperback, eBook, and Spiral-bound.
The publication date of a specific edition. Accepted formats are YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY.
The edition of a book, such as '3rd', 'Revised', or 'Anniversary Edition'.
Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price — the recommended price set by the publisher.
A full textual summary or description of the book's content.
A list of subject headings or categories the book belongs to, used for classification and discovery.
ISBNs of related editions of the same work (e.g., hardcover, paperback, digital) with their binding types.
Real-time pricing information from various merchants including condition, shipping, and purchase links. Available on Pro plan and higher.
The daily API call quota associated with an API key, including total allowed, spent, and remaining calls.
The number of results returned per page. Maximum value is 1,000.
The page number to retrieve. The API will not return more than 10,000 total results regardless of pagination.
Date filter for books published on or after a given date. Formats: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Cannot be combined with 'year'.
Date filter for books published on or before a given date. Formats: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Cannot be combined with 'year'.
Search scope constraint for book queries. Options: title, author, date_published, subjects. Empty value searches all columns.
When true, returns only books where the title or author exactly contains all words in the query.
A date filter (YYYY-MM-DD) used in the feed endpoint to retrieve books updated on or after this date.
Authentication scheme for the ISBNdb API. An API key must be supplied in the Authorization HTTP header.
